ModMetaData.name: Storage Group Quotas
ModMetaData.author: Steel-Shadow
ModMetaData.description:
Storage-group-wide item quotas for RimWorld 1.6.
Choose between a total-count quota for the entire vanilla storage group and a Similar stacks ×N mode that keeps several independently reservable stacks for combat logistics. Incoming hauling respects the remaining quota. Exact excess quantities are hauled outside the group instead of being left in place.
Requires Harmony. Includes optional Pick Up And Haul compatibility. Incompatible with Stack Gap.
为 RimWorld 1.6 提供作用于整个原版“存储组”的物品配额。
可切换“整个仓库数量”和“类似堆栈 ×N”模式。后者会保留多个可由不同 Pawn 分别预留的独立堆栈，方便战斗时同时换弹。入库搬运遵守剩余配额，超量部分会按准确数量搬出存储组。
需要 Harmony；可选兼容 Pick Up And Haul；与 Stack Gap 不兼容。
